title: graphpg configuration
description: One file for every environment: shared settings, then `dev:` and `prod:` blocks for what differs. Strings may read the environment: ${NAME} or ${NAME:-default} (quote them inside [] and {})

dev.description: Settings that differ in dev mode (`--mode dev`), merged over the ones above

prod.description: Settings that differ in prod mode (the default), merged over the ones above

deprecated.description: Deprecate the field, with this reason

omit.description: Hide the column from every type, input, filter and ordering

reverse_field_name.description: Name of the to-many relation field on the referenced type (its connection is <name>Connection)

omit_reverse.description: Hide the to-many relation fields on the referenced type

settings.database.description: The PostgreSQL connection, the schemas to expose and the read replicas

schemas.description: Database schemas to expose, the first being the default (default app_public)

sql_comments.description: Append a sqlcommenter comment to every statement (default true)

settings.auth.description: Authentication with OAuth 2.0 access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`), whose claims set the PostgreSQL role and the settings Row-Level Security policies read. Off by default

issuer.description: Authorization server issuer: tokens' `iss` must equal it; signing keys are discovered from its metadata

audience.description: This API's identifier(s): tokens' `aud` must contain one

jwks_uri.description: JSON Web Key Set URL, when not discovered from the issuer

algorithms.description: Accepted signature algorithms (default: the asymmetric ones, or HS256 with `secret`)

token_type.description: Required `typ` header, e.g. `at+jwt` (RFC 9068); unchecked when unset

roles.description: The PostgreSQL roles requests run as; tokens never choose one (their claims are data for RLS policies)

authenticated.description: Role of requests with a valid token; unset, the engine's database user

anonymous.description: Role of requests without a token; unset, they are rejected (401)

session_variables.description: Settings a request's claims are written to

claims_setting.description: Setting holding every claim as JSON (default `request.jwt.claims`)

prefix.description: Prefix of a setting per top-level claim (default `request.jwt.claim.`; empty: none)

mappings.description: Claim (name or dot-separated path) -> setting name

settings.rbac.description: Prune the generated APIs to what a PostgreSQL role may access

role.description: Role whose privileges are inspected (default: the connected user)

settings.debug.description: Diagnostics added to responses. Never enable them in production

sql.description: Include the generated SQL in the response `extensions`

explain.description: Include PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) output of every statement

statements.description: Serve GET /debug/statements: the most expensive operations so far (pg_stat_statements), with the indexes they lack. On in dev mode; dev only

enabled.description: Serve the GraphQL API at /graphql (default true)

ui.description: Serve the GraphiQL IDE at /graphiql (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

persisted_queries.description: Operations sent by hash (`extensions.persistedQuery.sha256Hash`) or manifest id (`documentId`), and the allow-list

enabled.description: Accept persisted queries; off, a request naming one gets PERSISTED_QUERY_NOT_SUPPORTED (default false)

automatic.description: Automatic persisted queries: a hash sent with its text registers it in memory (default true; ignored with allow_list)

manifest.description: JSON file of known operations: an Apollo persisted query manifest or a map of ids to texts

allow_list.description: Run only the manifest's operations (default false)

settings.openapi.description: The REST API and its OpenAPI description

enabled.description: Serve the REST API at /rest (default true)

ui.description: Serve the Scalar API reference at /scalar (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

spec.description: Serve the OpenAPI 3.1 document at `path` (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

path.description: Path to serve the OpenAPI document at (default: /openapi.json)

settings.rest.description: Alias for openapi: the REST API and its OpenAPI description

enabled.description: Serve the REST API at /rest (default true)

ui.description: Serve the Scalar API reference at /scalar (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

spec.description: Serve the OpenAPI 3.1 document at `path` (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

path.description: Path to serve the OpenAPI document at (default: /openapi.json)

settings.watch.description: Schema watching on DDL changes and auto-export

enabled.description: Re-introspect on DDL changes (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

export.description: On each schema change, write the export files (default true)

settings.events.description: Event triggers: webhooks on row changes (captured in the change's transaction) and on schedules

enabled.description: Capture and deliver events (default true; nothing happens without triggers or schedules)

schema.description: The schema of graphpg's event table and functions (default graphpg_events)

install.description: auto: install at startup; manual: only check (`graphpg events sql` prints the DDL)

url.description: The endpoint the event is POSTed to as JSON

headers.description: Headers added to every request (values may read ${NAME})

secret.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret: whsec_<base64>, or any text

timeout.description: How long a request may take (default 10s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

backoff.description: Wait before the second attempt, doubled for each further one (default 10s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

max_backoff.description: Longest wait between attempts (default 1h), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

operations.description: The changes that raise an event (default: all)

columns.description: Updates raise an event only when one of these columns changes

url.description: The endpoint the event is POSTed to as JSON

headers.description: Headers added to every request (values may read ${NAME})

secret.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret: whsec_<base64>, or any text

timeout.description: How long a request may take (default 10s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

backoff.description: Wait before the second attempt, doubled for each further one (default 10s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

max_backoff.description: Longest wait between attempts (default 1h), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

cron.description: 5-field cron in UTC (`0 3 * * *`), or @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly. Without it, only events scheduled from SQL are sent

catch_up.description: Slots missed while no instance ran: the most recent one, or none (default latest)

concurrency.description: Requests in flight at once, per instance (default 4)

poll.description: Longest wait for new events without a notification (default 5s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

lease.description: How long a claimed event is held before another instance may deliver it (default 60s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

retention.description: Delivered events are deleted after (default 7d), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

dead_retention.description: Dead events are deleted after (default 30d), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

settings.subscriptions.description: Live queries: a Subscription type with the Query type's root fields, whose result is sent again when it changes (re-run every interval, batched)

interval.description: How often subscriptions' queries run again (default 1s, at least 50ms), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

source.description: Where they run: a read replica when there is one, or the primary (default replica)

max_per_instance.description: Subscriptions open at once on an instance (default 10000)

max_per_subject.description: Subscriptions open at once per client (token `sub`, or address), per instance (default 100)

batch.description: Subscriptions run in one statement at most (default 100)

concurrency.description: Connections a round of re-runs uses at once (default 4)

keep_alive.description: Keep-alive messages on idle streams (default 15s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

init_timeout.description: How long a WebSocket client has to send connection_init (default 10s), with a unit: `500ms`, `10s`, `5m`, `1h`, `7d`

settings.reload.description: Schema reload without a restart, in any mode: on NOTIFY <channel> and SIGHUP. The configuration is the one the server started with

settings.export.description: Export paths for schema and configuration files

graphql.description: Path to export GraphQL SDL schema (default schema.graphql)

subgraph.description: Path to export Apollo Federation Subgraph SDL (default subgraph.graphql)

config_schema.description: Path to export YAML config JSON schema (default graphpg.schema.json)

openapi.description: Path to export the OpenAPI 3.1 document (default openapi.json; YAML for .yaml / .yml)

pin.description: At startup, compare the exported schema files with the schema the database generates now: `fail` (default in prod mode) refuses to start on drift, `warn` (default in dev mode) logs it, `off` does not check. Files that do not exist pin nothing.

settings.entities.description: Tables, views, materialized views and foreign tables, shared by every API

deprecated.description: Deprecate the function's fields, with this reason

field_name.description: Field name on the table's type

settings.types.description: Enum and composite types (CHECK-closed text columns as <table>.<column>)

settings.extensions.description: Objects owned by extensions are hidden unless their extension is exposed

expose.description: Extensions whose tables, views and functions are exposed ("*": all)

integrations.description: What graphpg infers from the extensions the schema uses (docs/extensions.md): auto (default) or off, by integration

settings.limits.description: Safety limits shared by the GraphQL and REST APIs, enforced on the plan

default.description: Rows of a connection asked for neither `first` nor `last` (default 100)

max.description: Largest `first` / `last`, and the most rows of a list that has no page size (default 1000). A number, or `off` for no limit.

depth.description: Deepest nesting of rows (default 10). A number, or `off` for no limit.

cost.description: Largest estimated cost: the rows an operation reads (default 10000000). A number, or `off` for no limit.

bulk_rows.description: Most rows one write inserts or an update or delete by filter affects, nested writes included (default 1000). A number, or `off` for no limit.

require_filter.description: GraphQL `update<Types>(where:)` and `delete<Types>(where:)` with no condition (every row) need `unfiltered: true`; REST always asks for it (default false)

groups.description: Most groups an aggregate request may return (default 10000). A number, or `off` for no limit.

request_body_bytes.description: Largest request body in bytes (default 1048576). A number, or `off` for no limit.

count_threshold.description: `Prefer: count=estimated` counts exactly up to this many estimated rows, and uses the planner estimate above (default 10000). A number, or `off` for no limit.

statement_timeout.description: `statement_timeout` of every connection, with a unit: `500ms`, `30s`, `2m`, `1h`; `off` for none (default 30s)

rate_limit.description: Requests per client and minute over GraphQL and REST, per instance (off by default)

anonymous.description: Requests without a valid access token, by IP address (default 60 a minute)

requests_per_minute.description: Requests per minute. A number, or `off` for no limit.

authenticated.description: Requests with a valid access token, by `key_claim` (default 600 a minute)

requests_per_minute.description: Requests per minute. A number, or `off` for no limit.

key_claim.description: The claim naming a client (default sub)

trusted_proxies.description: Addresses or CIDR ranges of proxies whose X-Forwarded-For names the client

max_clients.description: Clients tracked at most per instance (default 100000)

settings.errors.description: How database errors reach clients, over GraphQL and REST

detail.description: `masked` (default in prod) hides the database's message; `full` (default in dev) shows it

map.description: SQLSTATE codes or constraint names -> the problem they become. A constraint name wins over a SQLSTATE. In prod a mapped error shows only its title

status.description: HTTP status of the REST problem (default 400)

title.description: Problem title (default: the status's reason phrase)

code.description: Machine-readable code, `errors[].extensions.code` in GraphQL (default: the SQLSTATE)

settings.telemetry.description: Logs, Prometheus metrics, traces and OpenTelemetry (OTLP) export, for Prometheus, an OpenTelemetry collector or the Grafana LGTM stack. Read at startup

service_name.description: service.name of exported telemetry (default: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME, else graphpg)

level.description: Lowest level logged (`error`, `warn`, `info`, `debug`, `trace`) or a filter like `info,graphpg=debug`; RUST_LOG wins when set (default info)

format.description: `text` (default) or `json`: one object per line, with the request's trace id

enabled.description: Serve metrics (default: on in dev mode, off in prod)

listen.description: Serve the endpoint on a listener of its own, like `0.0.0.0:9464`, instead of the API's port

traces.description: One span per request, with planning, compilation and execution inside it

sample_ratio.description: Share of new traces recorded (default 1); a request with a W3C traceparent follows the caller's decision

otlp.description: Push traces, metrics and logs over OTLP/HTTP (protobuf)

endpoint.description: Base URL, like http://localhost:4318: signals go to /v1/traces, /v1/metrics and /v1/logs (default: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, else no export)

headers.description: Headers of every export request, like Authorization (use ${NAME} for credentials)

interval.description: How often metrics are pushed, with a unit: `10s`, `1m` (default 60s)

settings.search.description: Search root fields return the best matches, without pagination
